stem.text: In the diagram, X is the Boltzmann distribution for the energies of the particles in a reaction and $E_\text{A1}$ is the activation energy for that reaction.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curves labelled X, Y and Z (number of molecules against molecular energy), with vertical lines marked E_A2 and E_A1 on the energy axis

A.text: $E_\text{A2}$ is the activation energy at a higher temperature.

B.text: $E_\text{A2}$ is the activation energy at a lower temperature.

C.text: Y is the Boltzmann distribution at a lower temperature.

D.text: Z is the Boltzmann distribution at a higher temperature.
